annotations.title: Send a test email with a brand's sending identity

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Sends one test email to your own account address with the brand's current identity and reports the From actually used (`via` mailbox or resend; a domain that is not verified yet shows the flayr address).
(Wraps POST /api/v2/brands/{id}/sending-identity/test.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_sending_identity_send_test
title: Send a test email with a brand's sending identity
